changes: Added dispatch_reassign so an accepted/completed worker dispatch can be reassigned as a fresh-context follow-up with explicit worker role, parentDispatchId lineage, accepted-local previous dispatch guard, role-consistent prompt instructions, command aliases, phase/process policy registration, and smoke coverage.
usage: After a worker dispatch has accepted-local receipt, run lattice dispatch_reassign --dispatchId=<previous> --role=lattice-implementer --objective=<follow-up instructions>; open the returned promptFile and launch that role with fresh context.
expectedOutcome: The CLI reports Worker reassignment ready with mode=fresh-context, role=lattice-implementer, previousDispatchId, a new dispatchId, parentDispatchId, promptFile, and no full-history fork requirement.
actualTranscript: User acceptance transcript recorded dispatch_reassign output: Worker reassignment ready, mode: fresh-context, previousDispatchId: D-B-99d4-user-acceptance-final, dispatchId: D-B-99d4-fake-mrcz2hq3, role: lattice-implementer, promptFile present, and nextAction says no full-history fork is required; prompt contains Role: lattice-implementer and Work in role: lattice-implementer.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference remains; the observed output matches the expected role-aware fresh-context reassignment, and BUG-001 fixed the earlier stale Work in role: overflow-worker prompt conflict.
limitations: Uses accepted-local previous dispatch evidence before reassignment; unrun/prepared dispatches are intentionally rejected instead of being reassigned.
pitfalls: Review found two high issues plus a TEST bug: initial smoke used a generic role, prepared-only dispatches could be reassigned, and inherited execution instructions kept the old role. All were fixed with reviewer passes, validate PASS, done-required PASS, delivery PASS, and transcript evidence.
